topSignals.title: Bloom Energy's S&P 500 inclusion took effect at today's open, replacing Molson Coors Beverage Co.
topSignals.text: — the first pure-play energy company added to the index since 2022. Last available close (Fri Sept 18) was $265.63 (-5.39%), after-hours $267.05; index-fund rebalancing flow is the incremental driver today, with no new commercial news attached to the inclusion itself. Yahoo Finance | StockAnalysis

topSignals.title: New AI data center deployment, not previously logged: Bloom Energy fuel cells tapped for Aligned Data Centers' "Project Phoenix,"
topSignals.text: a 2 GW, three-facility campus in Shippingport, PA, running on dedicated on-site natural-gas-fed SOFC power rather than grid draw. RBC Capital called it another "meaningful proof point" for Bloom's data-center strategy and kept an Outperform rating with a $335 price target. This adds a new named hyperscale-adjacent deployment to the standing pipeline (Bloom-AEP, Bloom-Brookfield, Bloom-Oracle, Bloom-Equinix, Bloom-Nebius). Yahoo Finance / RBC

topSignals.title: Priority stacks Elcogen and Topsoe: fifth consecutive quiet day
topSignals.text: — no new announcements from either since Elcogen's Sept 15 Shanghai HyEnergy agreement and Topsoe's Sept 7 Uniper e-methanol FEED contract. Direct site checks (elcogen.com/newsinsights, topsoe.com/press-releases) confirm no new releases in the last 24-48h; a web-search result dated "Sept 19" about an Elcogen Tallinn factory opening appears to be a re-surfaced older article describing the same ELCO I / 360 MW-per-year ramp already on file, not a new event.

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new news beyond Top Signal #3. Standing status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2, ELCO I Tallinn ramping toward 360 MW/yr.
Topsoe (priority): No new news beyond Top Signal #3. SOEC-only Herning factory (500 MW/yr) remains the flagship asset; SOFC/data-center pathway still deferred under the May 2026 roadmap review.

New entrant identified (backfill, not from today): Teragen Energy, a Berkeley Lab spinout developing modular SOFC systems for data centers, industrial sites and utilities, closed an oversubscribed $6M pre-seed round (announced Aug 26, co-led by BEVC and Energy Capital Ventures; AP Ventures, AIC Ventures, MassCEC and UntroD Capital Asia also participated). Not previously carried in this monitor — flagged now for the watch list. PR Newswire
Ceres Power: No new stack/cell news; H1 2026 results still due before market open Wednesday Sept 23 (consensus loss ~$0.0644/share, revenue ~$34.75M) — unchanged.
No new stack/cell announcements found from Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, or Aisin in the last 24-48h.

New — see Top Signal #2:* Bloom Energy / Aligned Data Centers "Project Phoenix," 2 GW campus, Shippingport, PA. Rest of standing pipeline unchanged: Bloom-AEP 1 GW ($2.65B), Bloom-Brookfield up to $25B EaaS framework, Bloom-Oracle Project Jupiter up to 2.8 GW, Bloom-Equinix >100 MW/19 sites (six states), Bloom-Nebius $2.6B (Vineland, NJ), Hitachi-Bloom Japan collaboration, FCEL-Fit Energy up to 380 MW (Phase 0 = 30 MW), FCEL-Inuverse Korea (AI Daegu Data Center, up to 100 MW), FCEL Texas 75 MW Capacity Reservation Agreement, FCEL-SDCL up to 450 MW, Ceres-Centrica UK/Europe pipeline, Ceres-Weichai China manufacturing licence, EU EcoEdge PrimePower (Equinix Milan dual-fuel SOFC/UPS/battery pilot), Doosan Fuel Cell-HyAxiom KRW 501.4B U.S. AI data center supply contract through 2028. No new hyperscaler (Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta, Oracle/OpenAI, xAI) direct fuel-cell procurement found in the last 24-48h.

Bloom Energy (BE): Last close Fri Sept 18: $265.63 (-5.39%), after-hours $267.05 (+0.53%); day's range $265.00-285.10, volume 73.5M — a sharp pullback from the $270-288 range of Sept 17-18 intraday highs. S&P 500 formal entry effective today's open (Top Signal #1). Market cap $78.2B (+320% YTD), analyst consensus "Buy," average price target $280.24. Securities class-action (Feb 27 2025-Jul 8 2026 purchasers, scandium-sourcing allegations) lead-plaintiff deadline Sept 28; multiple plaintiff firms (Robbins LLP, Kaplan Fox) still running reminder press releases — no new substantive development. Q3 earnings Oct 27.

FuelCell Energy (FCEL): Last close Fri Sept 18: $18.11 (+2.26%), after-hours $18.12; day's range $17.17-18.38. New: Hagens Berman Sloane Sarko (HBSS) confirmed a Nov 10, 2026 lead-plaintiff deadline for its securities class action over Q3 disclosures tied to the Fit Energy CEPA Phase 0 charges ($17M in cost overruns disclosed Sept 2, triggering the 15.7% single-day drop) — a firmer date than the general "investigation" announcements logged earlier this month. Backlog stands at $3.6B per the Q3 transcript; positive adjusted EBITDA still targeted for Q4 2027. Citi (Neutral, $19 PT) and Craig-Hallum (Buy, $22 PT) coverage from last week stands; analyst consensus "Buy," average target $20.33.
Ceres Power (CWR.L): H1 2026 results due Sept 23 before market open — unchanged.

lcoe.text: No new capex/opex/efficiency figures today. Henry Hub carry-forward unchanged: futures through September 2026 remain below $3.00/MMBtu; EIA expects spot to stay sub-$3.00 until November; full-year 2026 EIA average estimate ~$3.43-3.44/MMBtu — still below the model's carried $4.00-4.30/MMBtu assumption; worth reconciling.

Regulatory carry-forward, unchanged: both federal cost-shift bills remain dead; Germany's EEG-Novelle 2027 gets its first Bundestag reading Sept 24 — worth watching for self-generation/behind-the-meter treatment once the bill text is debated, as it could shift the German SOFC data-center case either direction.

Bloom's own techno-economic claim (background, unverified, carried from Sept 17): 800V DC-native SOFC delivery reduces non-compute capex for a 1 GW AI data center by $3.6B (27%) and 5-year TCO by $5.5B (9%) vs. conventional AC infrastructure — vendor-published, useful directionally on the value of eliminating AC/DC conversion stages, not a validated LCOE input.

Pending calendar: Ceres H1 results (Sept 23), Germany EEG-Novelle first Bundestag reading (Sept 24), Bloom lead-plaintiff deadline (Sept 28), PJM backstop bid window (Sept 30-Oct 21), Bloom Q3 earnings (Oct 27), FCEL lead-plaintiff deadline (Nov 10).
